findings.disposition_rationale: The spec (Writer step 4) defines the digest line as the first matching line after the closing fence within the section; the digest must equal the sha256 of the same block, so a later line gives an attacker no new capability.
Withdrawn by the reviewer; conformantRound rejects approve-with-objections and revise-without-objections both.
By design: the digest covers the block's single JSON line, which is the anchored data. The headline and summary lines are presentation; signing the whole comment is out of scope in the spec.
The writer has no round files to compare against, so it checks the range rules the spec lists; a larger rounds_total than the evidence supports is not detectable at this layer.
